title: Technical Lead - Technical Operations
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and provide L2 support for Value Added Services (VAS) platforms, primarily SMSC and USSD.
* Manage production incidents, perform impact assessment, lead incident bridge calls, and ensure timely resolution within defined SLAs.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents and drive preventive and corrective actions.
* Perform system administration and troubleshooting on Linux servers.
* Develop and execute basic to intermediate automation scripts using Python, Bash, or PowerShell to improve operational efficiency.
* Execute basic database administration and troubleshooting activities on MySQL and Oracle databases.
* Monitor application health, system performance, and service availability while proactively identifying potential risks.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Customer Support teams for issue resolution, deployments, and change management activities.
* Support software upgrades, patch deployments, and production releases while ensuring minimal business impact.
* Maintain operational documentation, incident reports, and knowledge base articles.
* Ensure adherence to ITIL processes, operational governance, and customer SLAs.
* Demonstrate a basic understanding of GSM network elements and their interaction with telecom applications.
* Possess working knowledge of Operating System Virtualization concepts to support virtualized environments.


**Required Skills**
**Technical Skills**
* VAS Platforms: SMSC, USSD
* Operating Systems: Linux
* Incident Management: Incident handling, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Production support
* Scripting: Python, Bash, PowerShell (Basic to Intermediate)
* Databases: MySQL, Oracle (Basic to Intermediate)
* Telecom: Basic knowledge of GSM architecture and network elements
* Virtualization: Basic understanding of OS virtualization technologies

title: Digital Engineer
description:
**Daily Responsibilities:**




 •
 



 Manage L2 incident tickets and service requests within defined SLAs.
 



 •
 



 Monitor M365 health dashboards and resolve service availability alerts daily.
 



 •
 



 Administer Microsoft Defender policies and investigate security alerts for endpoints.
 



 •
 



 Manage user identities, access permissions, and group memberships in Entra.
 



 •
 



 Deploy and manage Intune policies for mobile devices and laptops.
 



 •
 



 Ensure seamless integration of M365 security logs with SOC.
 



 •
 



 Execute license migrations and user data transfers to new subscriptions.
 



 •
 



 Maintain Microsoft Defender for Identity (MDI) configuration for on\-premises AD.
 



 •
 



 Analyze M365 and Azure logs to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
 



 •
 



 Facilitate Windows OS upgrades to Enterprise editions.
 



 •
 



 Generate weekly usage reports and security compliance posture for management.
 



 •
 



 Provide technical support for M365 Outlook, Teams, and Office applications.
 



 Additional Responsibilities:
 



 •
 



 Create and update technical documentation for internal knowledge base systems.
 



 •
 



 Conduct user awareness training sessions for new M365 feature adoption.
 



 •
 



 Build strong personal relationships with new customers and build rapport with their users
 



 •
 



 Assist in the rollout and configuration of Microsoft 365 Copilot.
 



 •
 



 Support internal audits by providing evidence of security policy compliance.
 



 •
 



 Coordinate with Microsoft OEM support for resolving complex L3 issues.
 



 Technical Capabilities:
 



 •
 



 Should have minimum BE/B Tech/MCA Degree or Equivalent
 



 •
 



 With minimum 03 years of relevant experience in M365 solution \&Valid Certification in M365 Components or MCSA.
 



 •
 



 Should have good communication skills.
